long_biography.plain_text:
Uzzeni grew up around Almar, the shoe factory established by his parents in Soriso. He eventually took over the company, redirected production toward safety footwear and developed the Aimont brand. After selling control to CVC, he led the combined JAL Group before leaving to create U-Invest and launch U-Power.

The new venture expanded through product development and later acquired JAL’s principal assets, bringing Aimont and Jallatte back into Uzzeni’s platform. In 2023, he sold majority control to NB Renaissance and reinvested for a 30 percent indirect interest through Fin Reporter. Uzzeni remains U-Power Group’s chairman, while the company’s factories, brands, patents and subsidiaries are corporate assets rather than property held by him personally.

uncertainties.detail: Pier Franco Uzzeni is also consistently styled P.F. Uzzeni or Franco Uzzeni in company material. Exact full-name corporate records, April 1950 birth, Italian nationality, Soriso/Paruzzaro geography and U-Power roles establish that these abbreviated references concern the same person; unrelated Uzzeni or Franco records were excluded.

Almar was founded by Uzzeni's parents, Alfonso and Maria, and provided his manufacturing experience and platform. Uzzeni later took it over, refocused it and sold control before founding the separate U-Power venture, so the parents' founder work is not attributed to him.

Official 2024 reporting shows NB Renaissance indirectly controlling 70 percent and Fin Reporter holding 30 percent of the acquisition vehicle. Uzzeni's economic relationship is described as an indirect minority interest; U-Power's subsidiaries, factories, brands and patents remain corporate assets.

Recent official material variously calls Uzzeni president, chairman, delegated director and chief executive, while current governance separately lists Eugenio Cecchin as CEO. The biographies use the unambiguous current chairman role and do not claim sole day-to-day executive authority.

Uzzeni created U-Power after the JAL period and was its sole owner before the 2023 majority sale, but his parents' Almar business supplied deep industry experience, assets and access. Self-made — advantaged start captures both mechanisms without treating the current U-Power stake as inherited.

The immutable record gives April 24, 1950. Companies House independently confirms April 1950, and regional reporting places his birth in Soriso in 1950; no equally authoritative public source independently confirmed the exact day, so no change is proposed to the populated birth fields.
Mandatory Forbes-first searches found no dedicated Forbes.com or Forbes Italy profile for Pier Franco Uzzeni. No Forbes social link is proposed.

The immutable record already contains an Instagram URL using the Franco Uzzeni name. Search indexing did not provide enough first-party biographical content to strengthen or remove that existing record, and no identity-safe personal LinkedIn or personal website was found; only the official U-Power company site is proposed.
Private addresses, unverified wealth estimates, changing company valuations and all private-vessel ownership, specifications and history were excluded from the biographies.
